name: Jeld-Wen- 3303 Lakeport

nadir.desc: The property consists of a long, narrow commercial building with a white roof and a smaller attached roof section|A large paved parking lot with marked spaces sits on one side of the building|A second paved parking lot with marked spaces sits on the street side|Trees and landscaping wrap the structure|The large neighboring warehouse occupies the lot immediately behind this building|A public road and sidewalk run along the frontage.

alpha.desc: The front of the building faces a public road with a paved parking lot, sidewalk, and trees along the elevation|The structure has a white roof with HVAC system units dotted and a long street-facing wall|A second parking lot is visible behind the building|The large neighboring warehouse sits beyond that lot|Landscaping and a sidewalk connect to the street corner.

bravo.desc: The left side of the building faces a paved parking lot along the street, with trees and a sidewalk at the corner|The white roof and end wall of the building are visible|The rear parking lot and neighboring warehouse continue behind the structure|Open ground and a marked crosswalk sit at the street edge.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building faces a large paved parking lot with marked spaces and accessible spaces|A smaller attached building sits at one end|Trees line the building and lot|The large neighboring warehouse is visible beyond the lot|Drive lanes connect this lot to the rest of the campus.

delta.desc: The right side of the building shows both parking lots, the white roof, and trees along the walls|The street-side lot and sidewalk run along the public road|The rear lot connects toward the neighboring warehouse|A sidewalk and crosswalk sit at the street corner.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from Lakeport Blvd into parking lots on both the street side and the campus side of the building. The site is a small commercial office-style building in front of a large industrial warehouse on the same campus. Pelican Elementary School sits across the nearby street. A golf course and additional plant buildings occupy the wider campus. Circulation space is good in both lots. Trees along the building may limit some side sightlines but do not block lot access.
